summary: Build a Smart City Environmental Monitoring capstone with IoT ingestion, reliable event streaming, stream processing, Azure SQL metadata, Azure Data Explorer time-series storage, a REST API, and a React dashboard. Include containerized AKS deployment, security, observability, cost controls, IaC, CI/CD, architecture documentation, and a walkthrough/interview script.

questions.question: Describe the features or processing behavior for Stream Processing Worker.
questions.answer: Consume sensor events from the broker; validate and filter invalid/out-of-range readings; deduplicate where appropriate; aggregate by sensor, location, and time window; detect threshold anomalies; write time-series results to Azure Data Explorer and metadata/health summaries to Azure SQL as appropriate; expose processing lag and health metrics.
